text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —*pant*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Losing is... unacceptable. I will—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wahahaha~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeeeeeeaaaaaaah!! Totally god-tier, no 
sweat at aaaaaall!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ha, no way...!! The one who's gonna win is 
me!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—No... The one who will seize victory 
today! The one who will claim the glory 
is...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“The winner is Daiichi Ruby! With an 
incredible turn of foot, she slips right 
past!!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Feels like our unstoppable charge starts 
right here! What race are we entering 
next?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, I really wanted to see her in the 
Takarazuka Kinen! Ryan and McQueen are 
running too, so Ruby definitely belonged 
there no matter how you look at it!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...It's still so dark...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyyy☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That was sooo freakin' amazing!! That was 
demonic! Pure demon-speed legs!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: A congratulatory hug!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I must politely decline. Besides... I have 
not yet earned your congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The next GⅠ is the Sprinters Stakes... We 
must secure victory there as well.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: If I drop even one, there is no future—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: This again?!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Man, both of us were totally played.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pyaaah!! Head over heels~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ruby just won't fall for me at all!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, that's what you meant?! Well, I 
kinda had a feeling!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So, what're we gonna do?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Gotta just push through on pure vibes!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Is what I thought, but... Aren't we just 
doing the exact same thing over again!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trai-piii~~!! What are adults supposed to 
do at times like this!?
choice_data_list:
There's a traditional method passed down 
from the past.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Does that mean...!
choice_data_list: If pushing doesn't work, try pulling!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I don't get it! How do party 
animals see it?!
choice_data_list: ...Create good momentum and ride the peak!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aah!! I get it!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That thing you're always teachin' me, 
Trainy-P!
choice_data_list: Let's save up our vibes for now.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright, and then explode right 
at the best moment, got it?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, so the race is still a bit further 
out? Gotta build up strength first, right?

A race where Daitaku Helios could unleash 
her full explosive power at a good time, 
and where Daiichi Ruby would also appear. 
That would be after our second summer 
training camp—
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Mile CS.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: K!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm gonna go look for the young lady! 
I couldn't talk to her earlier anyway!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure about that? Just going with 
Helios's mood. Won't that make the race 
kinda sloppy?

In truth, Daitaku Helios has made it this 
far riding mostly on her sheer vibes and 
natural talent. However, that alone won't 
be enough to win moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Not only Daiichi Ruby, who won today, but 
also K.S. Miracle from the younger 
generation, along with other rising 
forces—we'll surely be clashing with them 
soon."
choice_data_list:
Once you get stronger, you'll be able to 
enjoy it even more!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ho, I see~

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I was worried whether anyone 
besides us could even keep up with Helios, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Looks like you met a great Trainer, huh.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you can't keep looking down, ya 
know? I'm running in the Mile CS too—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna keep making 'em look up at me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next target race was decided: 
a second shot at the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're walking home? Are you going 
to be okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It will also serve as my cool-down, so 
there is no issue at all.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I see. Then let's go together.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You can count on me as a bodyguard, too. 
...Or maybe that sounds a bit too 
unreliable?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the thought. Besides, I doubt 
anyone would target someone like me now.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Why would you say that? You won in such a 
splendid way today, too!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...It is true that we were victorious. 
However..."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Will the light I seek truly lie down this 
path...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...! Please excuse me, I will take my 
leave.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah! Milady~~!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wait, Helios!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to let them be for now. Won't 
you party with me instead?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Love it!! Let's do it!! Let's throw a 
"Mile CS" Hype Party!!
